summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests pembrolizumab with radiation therapy, with or without olaparib, in women with metastatic triple-negative or hormone-receptor positive, HER2-negative breast cancer. Pembrolizumab is given as a 30-minute IV infusion every 3 weeks for 3 doses, olaparib is taken as tablets twice daily for 2 cycles of 21 days each, and radiation is given as 8-9 Gy in 3 fractions (or 30 Gy in 6 Gy fractions for large tumors). The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa pembrolizumab con radioterapia, con o sin olaparib, en mujeres con cáncer de mama metastásico triple negativo o con receptores hormonales positivos y HER2 negativo. El pembrolizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 30 minutos cada 3 semanas, durante 3 dosis; el olaparib se toma en tabletas dos veces al día durante 2 ciclos de 21 días cada uno; y la radiación se administra en 8-9 Gy en 3 fracciones (o 30 Gy en fracciones de 6 Gy para tumores grandes). La medida de resultado principal no está indicada en el registro.
who_for: Women at least 18 years old with triple-negative or ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.
Metastatic or recurrent disease in the stated breast cancer subtypes.
Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1, including a lesion that will not receive radiation.
For metastatic triple-negative disease, prior immunotherapy with progression and/or PD-L1-negative status.
not_for: More than 3 prior lines of systemic therapy for metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.
Prior grade 3 or higher immune-mediated side effects from immunotherapy.
Live vaccine within 30 days before the first study drug dose.
Recent systemic anticancer therapy or radiotherapy within the stated washout periods.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or another malignancy that is progressing or treated within 2 years.
